apadāna:

(i) the story of a person’s actions and their results (in the Apadāna collection); Abh 943 (~aṃ... itivutte); Ap 241,.21 (~aṃ sugatānaṃ kittayissaṃ mahesinaṃ); Thī-a 173,.23 (tatr’ idaṃ imissā theriyā ~aṃ); Ap-a 101,.4 (therānaṃ ~āni therāpadānāni); 238,.33 (āyasmato Mahāmoggallānattherassa ~aṃ); — (ii) one of the collections making up the Khuddaka-nikāya of the Pāḷi Canon; Mp III 159,.10 (asuttanāmakaṃ hi buddhavacanaṃ atthi seyyathīdaṃ jātakaṃ paṭisambhidā …theragāthā therīgāthā ~an ti); Pj I 12,.9 (khuddakapāṭho dhammapadaṃ … paṭisambhidā ~aṃ buddhavaṃso … khuddakanikāyo); Th-a III 204,.27 (vuttaṃ h’ etaṃ ~e); — 4. division; discrimination; Sp 1148,.13 (~aṃ vuccati paricchedo); —      °’-aṭṭhakathā,   f., the commentary on the Apadāna; Ap-a 102,.25 (visuddhajanavilāsaniyā ~āya); —       °-pāḷi,      °-pāli,   f., the text of the Apadāna; Th-a II 201,.17 (taṃ ~iyā virujjhati); III 204,.31 (~iyaṃ āgatā therā); Thī-a 268,.18 (imā pana catasso gāthā … ~iyaṃ pi saṅgahaṃ āropitā); —        °-sobhana,   mf (~ī) n., made clear or manifest by actions or by its results; A I 102,.3 (~ī paññā, Be so; Ce °-sobhinī; Ee, Se apadāne sobhati; Mp II 169,.5 : ~ī paññā ti yā paññā nāma apadānena sobhati, bālā ca paṇḍitā ca attano cariten’ eva pākaṭā hontī ti attho); —      anapadāna,   mfn., 1. without discrimination; without discernment; Vin I 321,.38 (bālo hoti avyatto āpattibahulo ~o gihisaṃsaṭṭho viharati; see Sp 1148,.13 : ~o ti apadānavirahito, āpattiparicchedavirahito ti attho); — 2. without absolutely excellent past actions; Th-a III 204,.32 (yesaṃ pana taṃ [apadānaṃ] n’ atthi te ~ā) ≠ Thī-a 269,.14 (tā ~ā, Ce so; Be, Ee, Se nāpadānā [?]) Th-a III 205,.4 (yesam pana ati-ukkaṃsagatam apadānaṃ n’ atthi te idha ~ā ti vuttā); —      sāpadāna,   mfn., 1. of absolutely excellent past actions; Th-a III 204,.31 (yesaṃ hi purimesu sammāsambuddhassa … puññakiriyavasena pavattitaṃ sāvakapāramitāsaṅkhātaṃ atthi apadānaṃ te ~ā, seyyathā pi apadānapāḷiyaṃ āgatā therā) ≠ Thī-a 269,.13; — 2. containing stories of actions and their results;? Ap-a 1,16* (~assa Apadānass’ asesato … dīpissaṃ … atthasaṃvaṇṇanaṃ); — see also avadāna, buddhāpadāniya.
